MEMBERSHIP TERMS AND CONDITIONS

1. Your membership
1.1 These terms form a contract between you and Fitbox Leisure Limited (company number 01234567), trading as Fitbox Gyms.
1.2 Your membership starts on the date shown in your welcome email.

2. Fees
2.1 A joining fee of £20.00 is payable when you join.
2.2 Your first 2 months are charged at £9.99 per month as an introductory offer.
2.3 After the introductory offer, your membership costs £29.99 per month, collected by Direct Debit.
2.4 Each year on 1 April your monthly fee will increase by £2.00.

3. Minimum term and cancellation
3.1 Your membership has a minimum term of 12 months.
3.2 After the minimum term your membership will automatically renew on a rolling monthly basis.
3.3 You must give us 30 days’ notice to cancel. You can cancel online in the members’ area of our app.
3.4 If you cancel during the minimum term, an early exit fee equal to the remaining monthly fees applies.
